shortDescription: Russian state energy holding InterRAO RUS:IRAO, which was sanctioned by the European Union in July, has maintained electricity exports broadly steady in January - August from the same period in 2025, company board member Alexandra Panina said.

children: , which was sanctioned by the European Union in July, has maintained electricity exports broadly steady in January - August from the same period in 2025, company board member Alexandra Panina said.
Earlier this year, she said Russia's sole electricity exporter aimed to keep electricity exports in 2026 at the 2025 level, when exports totalled 7.435 billion kilowatt-hours.
Kazakhstan is currently the main market for Russian electricity exports.

InterRAO was placed under European Union sanctions in July as part of the EU's 21st sanctions package against Russia over its actions in Ukraine. The EU said the measures were intended to exert pressure on Russia's critical infrastructure.
